tools.name: xrpl_explain_tx
tools.description: FREE safety check: explain an XRPL transaction in plain English before signing it (JSON or hex blob) and flag risks such as wallet-drainer patterns, fake RLUSD issuers, missing destination tags and partial payments. Returns a verdict: looks_normal, review or do_not_sign.

tools.name: x402_doctor
tools.description: FREE: check whether an x402 paid endpoint is configured so AI agents can actually pay it (HTTP 402, PAYMENT-REQUIRED v2 header, XRPL invoiceId/sourceTag, RLUSD issuer, payTo can receive on-ledger, discovery file). Returns a score and exact fixes.

tools.name: xrp_track_record
tools.description: Launch Lab's graded record of daily XRP calls since Oct 8 2026 (hits, misses, streak). Free.

tools.name: xrp_brief_sample
tools.description: A free, cached (up to 6 hours) XRP brief: price, regime/volatility, model outlook, liquidity levels, derivatives, events, flows, news. Live data is pay-per-call (see xrp_paid_endpoints).

tools.name: xrp_paid_endpoints
tools.description: List the live, pay-per-call XRP data endpoints (x402 on the XRP Ledger, 0.0001-0.05 XRP per call) and how an agent pays for them.

tools.name: xrpl_wallet_report_preview
tools.description: Free wallet safety preview: heuristic score and up to three issues; full report is paid. Public ledger reads only, no wallet signing.
